definition: good enough for what is needed
example: The bake sale raised an adequate amount of money for the class trip.

definition: hard but easily cracked or snapped
example: The old leaves were so brittle that they crumbled in my hand.

definition: to make someone do something
example: The heavy rain compelled the referees to stop the game.

definition: saying a lot in few words; short and clear
example: Mr. Ruiz asked for a concise summary of no more than three sentences.

definition: to reduce something until little or none is left
example: Running the heater all night can deplete the battery.

definition: causing sadness or gloom; very poor
example: After a dismal first half, the team rallied to win.

definition: extremely happy and excited
example: Vince was elated when his test score came back.

definition: able to be done; practical
example: Finishing the project by Friday is feasible if we split the work.

definition: careful about spending money
example: My frugal grandfather saved every rubber band and twist tie.

definition: showing anger or opposition; unfriendly
example: The crowd grew hostile when the referee made a bad call.

definition: treating all sides equally; not taking sides
example: A good judge must stay impartial during the trial.

definition: certain to happen
example: With dark clouds overhead, rain seemed inevitable.

definition: danger of loss or harm
example: Skipping practice put his spot on the team in jeopardy.

definition: tired and lacking energy
example: The heat made everyone feel lethargic by the afternoon.

definition: very small in amount; not enough
example: The hikers shared a meager lunch of crackers and an apple.

definition: a person new to an activity
example: As a novice skier, she stayed on the bunny slope.

definition: no longer used because something newer exists
example: Flip phones became nearly obsolete once smartphones arrived.

definition: peaceful and not easily upset
example: The lake was placid early in the morning.

definition: very great or intense; showing deep understanding
example: The trip had a profound effect on how he viewed the world.

definition: to get better after illness or effort
example: She needed a week to recuperate after the flu.

definition: to look at or study very carefully
example: The coach scrutinized the game film for mistakes.

definition: long, slow, and dull
example: Copying the vocabulary list by hand was tedious.

definition: of little value or importance
example: Don't let a trivial mistake ruin your whole day.

definition: able to do many different things well
example: A versatile player, he can play guard or forward.

definition: carefully watching for danger or problems
example: The lifeguard stayed vigilant the whole afternoon.

definition: full of strong energy and devotion for a cause
example: The zealous fans painted their faces in team colors.

definition: real; not a copy
example: The museum confirmed the painting was authentic.

definition: easy to see or notice; standing out
example: His bright orange jacket was conspicuous in the crowd.

definition: not proud; modest about oneself
example: Even after winning, she stayed humble and thanked her teammates.

definition: to make or become larger
example: The school plans to expand the library next year.

definition: stiff and not able to bend; strict
example: The school has rigid rules about phones in class.

definition: hopeful and expecting good things
example: He was optimistic about the team's chances this season.

definition: happy to give or share
example: Our generous neighbor gave us a whole basket of tomatoes.

definition: calm and peaceful
example: The garden was tranquil except for the sound of birds.

definition: not clearly seen or understood; not well known
example: The directions were so obscure that we got lost.

definition: lasting only for a short time
example: The gym is a temporary classroom while the new wing is built.

definition: to speed up
example: The car accelerated as it merged onto the highway.

definition: to make or become smaller or less
example: The pain began to diminish after a few minutes of ice.

definition: to deeply respect and honor
example: Many students revere their favorite teacher.

definition: to prove that a statement is wrong
example: The scientist used new data to refute the old theory.
